title: Share Your Favourite GTA Memory to Win a Copy of GTA 6
description: Eurogamer launches its GTA Week coverage, inviting fans to share their favourite Grand Theft Auto gaming memories for a chance to win a copy of GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Embracing the GTA 6 Hype: Eurogamer Launches GTA Week

As the gaming world anticipates the arrival of the wildly awaited Grand Theft Auto 6, major gaming outlets are ramping up their coverage to celebrate Rockstar Games' iconic franchise. Recently, Eurogamer announced its dedicated "GTA Week" coverage, exploring all things Grand Theft Auto across the launch period of GTA 6. Alongside deep dives and nostalgic features, the publication has launched an exciting community initiative: share your favourite Grand Theft Auto gaming memory and win a copy of GTA 6.

## A Journey Through Grand Theft Auto History

For decades, the Grand Theft Auto series has shaped the landscape of open-world gaming. From the top-down origins of early titles to the revolutionary 3D leap of GTA 3, and the unprecedented, long-lasting success of GTA 5 and GTA Online, the franchise holds a special place in the hearts of millions of players worldwide.

Eurogamer's GTA Week serves as a platform to honor this legacy. By inviting the community to reflect on their personal highlights—whether it's cruising down the neon-lit streets of Vice City, causing chaos in San Andreas, or embarking on countless heists in Los Santos—the event bridges the gap between classic gaming nostalgia and the futuristic excitement surrounding GTA 6.

## Looking Ahead and Alternative Programming

While the excitement for GTA 6 reaches a fever pitch, Eurogamer is also offering a playful twist for its readership. Following the conclusion of GTA Week, the site has announced its "Not-GTA week" of counterprogramming, scheduled to run from November 23rd, offering a refreshing break for those looking for the exact opposite of Grand Theft Auto coverage.

For fans eager to secure their copy of the upcoming sequel, participating in community discussions and sharing those cherished, chaotic virtual memories offers a fun, engaging way to be part of the historic launch window celebration.

## Editor's Take

Community-driven events like Eurogamer's memory-sharing giveaway highlight just how deeply rooted Grand Theft Auto is in gaming culture. As we inch closer to GTA 6, leveraging nostalgia is a brilliant way to unite the player base. It is a reminder that beyond the cutting-edge graphics and massive open worlds, GTA's true magic lies in the personal stories we create while playing.
